'''Mulinda''' is a woman who stays with the [[rebel Aes Sedai]] in [[Salidar]]. She works as a serving woman. She is described as being skinny.
==Activities==
In Salidar, she shares a room with [[Emara]], [[Ronelle]] and [[Satina]]. [[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]] also stay in the same house.

When a [[bubble of evil]] attacks Salidar, Nynaeve and Elayne enter the room in which Mulinda and the other three girls are staying in order to help them. Nynaeve grabs Mulinda out from under and overturned bed and sends her to wake everyone else in the house who is still sleeping, and to help those that she can. Mulinda stumbles out of the room.
